description:
## What

Move the DNS cache machinery out of `CrestHttpClient` into a dedicated class.

## Source to move (from `src/fetcher/crest_http_client.cr`)

Class-level state:
- `@@dns_cache : Hash(String, {addr: Socket::IPAddress, expires: Time})`
- `@@dns_cache_lock : Mutex`
- `@@dns_max_entries : Int32`
- `@@dns_cleanup_registered : Bool`
- `@@dns_cleanup_proc : Proc(Nil)?`
- `DNS_EVICTION_BUFFER = 100`

Methods (class-level):
- `dns_max_entries=`, `dns_max_entries`
- `dns_cleanup_proc` (lazy init)
- `ensure_dns_cleanup_registered`
- `enforce_dns_limit`
- `clear_expired_dns`
- `clear_dns_cache` (currently `self.clear_dns_cache` does `new.clear_dns_cache`)

Instance methods on CrestHttpClient (delegate):
- `get_cached_dns(host)` → returns `Socket::IPAddress?`
- `cache_dns(host, addr)`
- `clear_dns_cache` (instance form used by the test helper)

## Why

- Class-level `@@` state mixed with per-instance state muddles ownership.
- The cache is independently useful and testable.
- Single responsibility: a `DNSCache` is a size-capped, TTL-bounded, mutex-guarded
  LRU-ish store. That is one concern.

## API target

    class Fetcher::CrestHttpClient::DNSCache
      def self.instance : DNSCache
      def self.clear : Nil
      def self.clear_expired : Nil
      def self.dns_max_entries=(value : Int32)
      def self.dns_max_entries : Int32
      def self.configure_cleanup : Nil

      def get(host : String) : Socket::IPAddress?
      def put(host : String, addr : Socket::IPAddress) : Nil
      def clear : Nil
    end

CrestHttpClient keeps:
- `@dns_cache = DNSCache.instance` (or just calls class methods).
- A thin instance facade so `get_cached_dns` / `cache_dns` keep working for the
  test helpers reopened in `spec/support/crest_http_client_test_helpers.cr`.

## Constraints

- No public API break for callers of `CrestHttpClient`.
- `clear_dns_cache` class method and instance method must keep working.
- The reopen in the spec helper must keep working without changes.
- `PeriodicCleanup.register_cleanup { ... }` registration must still happen
  exactly once on first insert.

## Done when

- New file `src/fetcher/crest_http_client/dns_cache.cr` exists.
- `crest_http_client.cr` requires it and delegates.
- `cache_dns`, `get_cached_dns`, `clear_dns_cache`, `clear_expired_dns`,
  `ensure_dns_cleanup_registered`, `enforce_dns_limit` no longer live in
  CrestHttpClient.
- `dns_cache_spec.cr` passes.
title: Extract DNSCache into src/fetcher/crest_http_client/dns_cache.cr
